messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a p99 jump in the console for the /generate ingress_path after the canary. Overall endpoint p99 is fine but this path jumped 320ms -> ~850ms. Anyone seeing retries included in rollups?
liam: Can you paste the exact console query you used? We recently changed some telemetry fields.
maya: Here it is:
```
select percentile(0.99, duration_ms) from requests
where ingress_path = '/generate' and time >= now() - interval '1 hour'
```
liam: That query is the raw rollup. We added an `is_retry` flag last week but the console rollups haven't surfaced it yet.
arthur: @maya thanks — quick note: we tag retries as `is_retry=true` on events but our rollup pipeline currently ignores that dimension when merging.
jess: :thinking: if retries are included they can seriously bias percentiles. For diagnostic views we should show both, but for SLOs probably exclude retries.
telemetry-bot: ingest: `is_retry` field indexed and available since 2026-03-22 04:12 UTC.
liam: quick sanity check — I ran an ad-hoc query excluding retries and got p99 ~340ms (vs 850ms when included). So retries are the tail culprit.
maya: OK that explains it. UX question: should console default to excluding retries for latency SLO tiles, or show include/exclude toggle?
arthur: Proposal: default exclude for SLO-badges, keep an "Include retries" toggle on diagnostic panes. Also surface `retry_ratio` and `sample_count` on tooltips.
jess: Agreed. Also we need to clarify grouping: console groups by `ingress_path` right now — that can capture client-side retries/fallbacks. Might be better to expose both `ingress_path` and canonical `endpoint` in the breakdown.
ben: Ben (product): leaning exclude-by-default for SLOs. Include toggle + docs for diagnostics.
liam: I'll open three tickets: `telemetry#fix-exclude-retries-rollup`, `console#ux-retry-toggle-badge`, `rollouts#retry-alerts`. Assigning telemetry one to myself.
maya: Thanks — can someone verify historical data/backfill won't break SLO history when we flip defaults?
arthur: I'll run a backfill validation tomorrow. For now I'll add a small note on the dashboard: "Note: legacy data may include retries; recent events have `is_retry` indexed."
jess: I'll sketch a micro mock for the toggle and badge (small tooltip copy + icon).
liam: Quick implementation note for telemetry team: when computing percentile rollups, filter `is_retry = true` out of SLO pipelines and include an aggregated `retry_ratio` metric in the rollup record. That way UI can compose both metrics without re-querying raw event store.
maya: +1. Thanks team. Ping me when PRs are up, I'll validate on the canary traffic. :thumbsup:
telemetry-bot: ticket created: telemetry#4321 (exclude retries in pctl rollup)
liam: filed console#987 (retry toggle + badge) and rollout#654 (fallback retry alert). Assigning console to @jess.
maya: Great — moving this to blocked->in-progress on the board.
arthur: I'll post back with backfill results and a short runbook for ops on how to interpret the old charts.
ben: Thanks all — product will sign off on exclude-by-default once we have backfill impact note.
maya: End of thread.
